d:
Cornered by backlash, her dream begins to crumble.
Akane thought one more chance could fix everything—until she steps into a place where “opportunity” comes with a price.

“Just endure it,” they said.
And suddenly, there’s no real choice left.

Behind closed doors, far from the cameras and applause,
she’s forced to decide how much of herself she’s willing to trade just to stay.

This isn’t redemption—
it’s where her fall truly begins.
